I see that there is at least someone who want better post group / reposting management. Now I want to propose some of idea that I have regarding this matter:

  • Repost and Share button

Repost and share is two different action. Let's start with repost first because it is simpler. You click a repost button, pop up asked for destination subvoat, fill it and submit. The reposted post will have the same title link as the original, while the comment link will goes to the original post discussion. It may have trouble with private subvoat though, so share your feedback here.

Share is same with repost, but with additional title and message. Title and message is filled with original's content, and free to be changed. Title link will go to same link as the original post, while message will go to it's own post discussion. Both will be flagged with something marking that it has been shared / reposted.

Or to make it simpler, only add share button. But add a link to original post's discussion.

Also, Any upvoat/downvoat should affect the original, but I'm not thinking about it yet.

  • Subvoat hierarchy (not recommended)

The idea is simple but complex to implement. Ex: v/supermario goes under v/gaming. Any v/supermario post reflected under v/gaming. I think multivoat (like multireddit) concept is better and easier.

  • Synonym

This is what stackoverflow's do with tag. It use synonym mechanism. Example: v/gaming v/game v/gamer may be one subvoat. Let's say that all of it is under v/gaming. All of the post have original subvoat label, such as v/game, is not converted to v/gaming in display.

This can also enable user to more detailing the subvoat without explicitly creating another, such as v/gaming_ps4, v/gaming_xbox. And can be useful for new-non crowded subvoat candidate such as v/gaming_[name of non-popular game].
